channel.description: Latest articles from DJ Murphy Publishers (djmurphy.co.uk)

item.title: PONY Magazine
item.description: PONY magazine is the only magazine written exclusively for pony-mad readers between the ages of six and sixteen. Packed with expert information on handling, caring for and riding ponies, it’s fun and interactive, providing readers with loads to do both on and off a horse or pony! Continue reading →

item.title: Horse&Rider
item.description: Horse&Rider is the UK’s best-selling equestrian monthly magazine, and was crowned Consumer Magazine of the Year, at the prestigious PPA Independant Publishing Awards in 2016.. It offers everything the horse enthusiast needs to know – and more! Top riders and leading equestrian experts provide up-to-date advice on horse care and riding. Each issue is packed with inspirational features, plus news and views, to ensure you’re truly in touch with the wonderful world of horses. Continue reading →

item.title: PONY: The Annual
item.description: Each year the team behind PONY Magazine creates a 100-page must-read annual packed with all new content. It features everything the young rider needs to know about riding and pony care, interesting breeds from around the world, exciting short stories, fun things to make and all sorts of puzzles and quizzes to keep fans busy for the whole year. Continue reading →

item.title: horseandrideruk.com
item.description: Horseandrideruk.com interacts seamlessly with Horse&Rider, to provide a complementary resource of trusted information in a variety of formats. It hosts a comprehensive library of veterinary articles, management tips, expert advice and training guides which are written by equestrian experts. The video section brings magazine features to life with footage shot in conjunction with our expert training articles, and also provides stand-alone training features and guides you can refer to time and time

item.title: ponymag.com
item.description: PONY readers love to chat – to each other and to PONY magazine! The PONY website gives them the perfect forum to let everyone know what they think about anything and everything, at the same time providing advice and information on ponies and riding. Continue reading →

item.title: Horse&Rider App
item.description: The digital edition of the UK's Number 1 equestrian monthly. The issue is interactive with clickable links, entry forms, embedded video and with you wherever your mobile device goes. Continue reading →

item.title: PONY Magazine App
item.description: The PONY app is a step beyond a beautiful and informative magazine on a mobile device, it is an interactive publication with links, video, entry forms, interactive activities and a more responsive reading experience. Continue reading →
